summary:
This change adds a comprehensive, standalone data retention policy module (`src/retention-policy.js`) with rigorous validation, canonicalization, and deterministic lifecycle computation, thoroughly tested via extensive and creative unit tests and supported by detailed fixtures for protocol compliance.

of the data city. 'You shall not pass!' it speaks to invalid format."
